welcome_page.title: Welcome to Your Profile
welcome_page.description:
A few questions about you and where you live.

Taking part is voluntary and you can skip any question. Your answers are not linked to your name, and no public authority receives them.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

Read the privacy notice before taking part: it explains who can access your answers and how long they are kept.

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

sections.title: About You
sections.description: A few questions about you. They help us understand how easy it is for different people to get around and reach the places they need.

questions.text: What is your highest completed level of education?
questions.help: If you are still studying, choose the last level you completed. If you studied abroad, choose the closest equivalent.

questions.text: Which of the following best describes your relationship to Municipio XII?

options.text: I live here (even without official registered residence)
I travel here regularly for work or study (Commuter)
I come here regularly for services, healthcare or to accompany someone
I come here now and then (e.g. to study, work or see people)
I'm visiting or staying for a short time (e.g. tourism, family)

questions.text: In which neighbourhood or area of Municipio XII do you currently live?
questions.help: If you use another name, choose the official neighbourhood closest to your home, or Other.

questions.text: How strongly do you feel connected to the people in your neighbourhood?
If you travel outside your neighborhood, what are the main reasons?

options.text: Better prices or more choice of services elsewhere
Lack of services in my neighborhood
Poor quality of services in my neighborhood
I prefer other neighborhoods or areas
I rarely or never travel outside my neighborhood

questions.text: Thinking about the income of everyone who lives with you, which of these best describes your household's economic situation?
questions.help: We ask because money can limit how people get around.

options.text: We struggle to cover basic needs
We cover basic needs easily, with little left over
We can afford most things, with some extras now and then
We are very comfortable and can easily afford extras

questions.text: Do you have a disability, health condition or limitation, even a mild one, that makes getting around harder?
questions.help: This question is about you, not people you help. Examples: walking, sight, hearing, attention, pain or mobility aids.

it.#Welcome to Your Profile: Ti diamo il benvenuto nel questionario sul tuo profilo
it.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: La tua risposta è stata registrata. Grazie per il tempo dedicato alla compilazione del questionario.
it.#What is your age group?: Qual è la tua fascia d’età?
it.#What is your highest completed level of: Qual è il tuo titolo di studio più elevato tra quelli conseguiti?
it.#If you are still studying, choose the l: Se stai ancora studiando, indica l'ultimo titolo conseguito. Se hai studiato all'estero, scegli il titolo equivalente più vicino.
it.#Which of the following best describes y: Quale delle seguenti opzioni descrive meglio il tuo rapporto con il Municipio XII?
it.#I live here (even without official regi: Ci vivo (anche senza residenza ufficialmente registrata)
it.#I travel here regularly for work or stu: Vengo qui regolarmente per lavoro o studio (pendolare)
it.#I come here regularly for services, hea: Ci vengo regolarmente per servizi, assistenza sanitaria o per accompagnare qualcuno
it.#I come here now and then (e.g. to study: Vengo qui ogni tanto (ad es. per studio, lavoro o per incontrare persone)
it.#I'm visiting or staying for a short tim: Sono qui in visita o per un breve periodo (ad es. turismo, famiglia)
it.#How strongly do you feel connected to t: Quanto è forte il legame che senti con le persone del tuo quartiere?
it.#Neither connected nor disconnected: Un legame né forte né debole
it.#Thinking about the income of everyone w: Pensando al reddito di tutte le persone che vivono con te, quale frase descrive meglio la vostra situazione economica?
it.#We struggle to cover basic needs: Abbiamo difficoltà a coprire le necessità di base
it.#We can cover basic needs: Riusciamo a coprire le necessità di base
it.#We cover basic needs easily, with littl: Copriamo facilmente le necessità di base, ma ci resta poco
it.#We can afford most things, with some ex: Possiamo permetterci quasi tutto, con qualche spesa extra ogni tanto
it.#We are very comfortable and can easily: Stiamo molto bene e possiamo permetterci facilmente spese extra
it.#Do you have a disability, health condit: Hai una disabilità, una condizione di salute o una limitazione, anche lieve, che rende più difficili i tuoi spostamenti?
it.#In which neighbourhood or area of Munic: In quale quartiere o zona del Municipio XII vivi attualmente?
it.#If you use another name, choose the off: Se usi un altro nome, scegli il quartiere ufficiale più vicino a casa tua, oppure Altro.
it.#If you travel outside your neighborhood: Se ti sposti fuori dal tuo quartiere, quali sono i motivi principali?
it.#Leisure activities (restaurants, cafes,: Attività nel tempo libero (ristoranti, bar, cinema, palestra)
it.#Better prices or more choice of service: Prezzi migliori o una maggiore scelta di servizi altrove
it.#Lack of services in my neighborhood: Mancanza di servizi nel mio quartiere
it.#Poor quality of services in my neighbor: Scarsa qualità dei servizi nel mio quartiere
it.#I prefer other neighborhoods or areas: Preferisco altri quartieri o altre zone
it.#I rarely or never travel outside my nei: Mi sposto raramente o mai fuori dal mio quartiere
it.#We ask because money can limit how peop: Lo chiediamo perché il denaro può limitare il modo in cui le persone si spostano.
it.#<p>A few questions about you. They help: Alcune domande su di te. Ci aiutano a capire quanto è facile per persone diverse muoversi e raggiungere i luoghi di cui hanno bisogno.
it.#<p>A few questions about you and where:
Alcune domande su di te e sul luogo in cui vivi.

La partecipazione è volontaria e puoi saltare qualsiasi domanda. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome e non vengono inviate a nessuna amministrazione pubblica.

Scopri di più su SmartUrbanity

Prima di partecipare, leggi l’informativa privacy: spiega chi può accedere alle tue risposte e per quanto tempo vengono conservate.
it.#This question is about you, not people: La domanda riguarda te, non le persone che aiuti. Esempi: cammino, vista, udito, attenzione, dolore o ausili per muoversi.

fr.#Welcome to Your Profile: Bienvenue dans le questionnaire sur votre profil
fr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Votre réponse a bien été enregistrée. Merci d’avoir pris le temps de remplir ce questionnaire.
fr.#What is your highest completed level of: Quel est le plus haut niveau d’études que vous avez terminé ?
fr.#If you are still studying, choose the l: Si vous faites encore des études, indiquez le dernier niveau terminé. Si vous avez étudié à l’étranger, choisissez l’équivalent le plus proche.
fr.#Upper secondary school (high school dip: Second cycle du secondaire (diplôme de fin d’études secondaires)
fr.#Which of the following best describes y: Laquelle de ces situations décrit le mieux votre lien avec le Municipio XII ?
fr.#I live here (even without official regi: J’habite ici (même sans résidence officiellement déclarée)
fr.#I travel here regularly for work or stu: Je viens ici régulièrement pour travailler ou étudier
fr.#I come here regularly for services, hea: Je viens ici régulièrement pour des services, des soins de santé ou pour accompagner quelqu’un
fr.#I come here now and then (e.g. to study: Je viens ici de temps en temps (par ex. pour étudier, travailler ou voir des gens)
fr.#I'm visiting or staying for a short tim: Je suis ici en visite ou pour un court séjour (par ex. tourisme, famille)
fr.#How strongly do you feel connected to t: Quelle est la force du lien que vous ressentez avec les personnes de votre quartier ?
fr.#Neither connected nor disconnected: Un lien ni fort ni faible
fr.#Thinking about the income of everyone w: En pensant aux revenus de toutes les personnes qui vivent avec vous, laquelle de ces propositions décrit le mieux la situation économique de votre foyer ?
fr.#We struggle to cover basic needs: Nous avons du mal à couvrir nos besoins essentiels
fr.#We can cover basic needs: Nous pouvons couvrir nos besoins essentiels
fr.#We cover basic needs easily, with littl: Nous couvrons facilement nos besoins essentiels, mais il nous reste peu
fr.#We can afford most things, with some ex: Nous pouvons nous permettre presque tout, avec quelques extras de temps en temps
fr.#We are very comfortable and can easily: Nous sommes très à l’aise et pouvons facilement faire des dépenses supplémentaires
fr.#Do you have a disability, health condit: Avez-vous un handicap, un problème de santé ou une limitation, même légère, qui rend vos déplacements plus difficiles ?
fr.#In which neighbourhood or area of Munic: Dans quel quartier ou quelle zone du Municipio XII habitez-vous actuellement ?
fr.#If you use another name, choose the off: Si vous utilisez un autre nom, choisissez le quartier officiel le plus proche de chez vous, ou Autre.
fr.#Person with a speech bubble: Personne avec une bulle de dialogue
fr.#If you travel outside your neighborhood: Si vous vous déplacez en dehors de votre quartier, quelles en sont les principales raisons ?
fr.#Leisure activities (restaurants, cafes,: Loisirs (restaurants, cafés, cinéma, salle de sport)
fr.#Visiting friends or family: Visite à la famille ou à des proches
fr.#Better prices or more choice of service: De meilleurs prix ou un plus grand choix de services ailleurs
fr.#Lack of services in my neighborhood: Manque de services dans mon quartier
fr.#Poor quality of services in my neighbor: Mauvaise qualité des services dans mon quartier
fr.#I prefer other neighborhoods or areas: Je préfère d’autres quartiers ou secteurs
fr.#I rarely or never travel outside my nei: Je vais rarement ou jamais en dehors de mon quartier
fr.#We ask because money can limit how peop: Nous posons cette question parce que l’argent peut limiter la façon dont les personnes se déplacent.
fr.#<p>A few questions about you. They help: Quelques questions sur vous. Elles nous aident à comprendre dans quelle mesure il est facile, pour différentes personnes, de se déplacer et de rejoindre les lieux dont elles ont besoin.
fr.#<p>A few questions about you and where:
Quelques questions sur vous et l’endroit où vous habitez.

La participation est volontaire et vous pouvez passer n’importe quelle question. Vos réponses ne sont pas associées à votre nom et ne sont transmises à aucune administration.

En savoir plus sur SmartUrbanity

Avant de participer, lisez la notice de confidentialité : elle explique qui peut accéder à vos réponses et combien de temps elles sont conservées.
fr.#This question is about you, not people: Cette question vous concerne, pas les personnes que vous aidez. Exemples : marche, vue, audition, attention, douleur ou aides à la mobilité.

de.#Welcome to Your Profile: Willkommen zum Fragebogen zu Ihrem Profil
de.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Ihre Antwort wurde gespeichert. Vielen Dank, dass Sie sich Zeit für diesen Fragebogen genommen haben.
de.#What is your highest completed level of: Welches ist Ihr höchster erworbener Bildungsabschluss?
de.#If you are still studying, choose the l: Wenn Sie noch in Schule, Studium oder Ausbildung sind, wählen Sie den zuletzt erworbenen Abschluss. Wenn Sie im Ausland gelernt oder studiert haben, wählen Sie den am ehesten vergleichbaren Abschluss.
de.#Which of the following best describes y: Welche der folgenden Aussagen beschreibt Ihre Beziehung zum Municipio XII am besten?
de.#I live here (even without official regi: Ich wohne hier (auch ohne offiziell gemeldeten Wohnsitz)
de.#I travel here regularly for work or stu: Ich komme regelmäßig zum Arbeiten oder Studieren hierher
de.#I come here regularly for services, hea: Ich komme regelmäßig hierher, um Dienstleistungen oder medizinische Versorgung zu nutzen oder um jemanden zu begleiten
de.#I come here now and then (e.g. to study: Ich komme ab und zu hierher (z. B. zum Lernen, Arbeiten oder um Leute zu treffen)
de.#I'm visiting or staying for a short tim: Ich bin zu Besuch oder nur kurz hier (z. B. Urlaub, Familie)
de.#How strongly do you feel connected to t: Wie stark fühlen Sie sich mit den Menschen in Ihrem Viertel verbunden?
de.#Thinking about the income of everyone w: Wenn Sie an das Einkommen aller Personen denken, die mit Ihnen zusammenleben: Welche dieser Aussagen beschreibt die wirtschaftliche Situation Ihres Haushalts am besten?
de.#We struggle to cover basic needs: Wir haben Schwierigkeiten, unsere grundlegenden Bedürfnisse zu bezahlen
de.#We can cover basic needs: Wir können unsere grundlegenden Bedürfnisse bezahlen
de.#We cover basic needs easily, with littl: Wir decken den Grundbedarf problemlos, aber es bleibt wenig übrig
de.#We can afford most things, with some ex: Wir können uns das meiste leisten, ab und zu auch etwas extra
de.#We are very comfortable and can easily: Uns geht es finanziell sehr gut, Extras sind leicht möglich
de.#Do you have a disability, health condit: Haben Sie eine Behinderung, eine gesundheitliche Beeinträchtigung oder Einschränkung, auch eine leichte, die Ihnen das Unterwegssein erschwert?
de.#In which neighbourhood or area of Munic: In welchem Viertel oder Gebiet des Municipio XII wohnen Sie derzeit?
de.#If you use another name, choose the off: Wenn Sie einen anderen Namen verwenden, wählen Sie das offizielle Viertel, das Ihrer Wohnung am nächsten liegt, oder Sonstiges.
de.#If you travel outside your neighborhood: Wenn Sie Ihr Viertel verlassen, was sind die wichtigsten Gründe dafür?
de.#Better prices or more choice of service: Bessere Preise oder eine größere Auswahl an Dienstleistungen anderswo
de.#Poor quality of services in my neighbor: Schlechte Qualität der Dienstleistungen in meinem Viertel
de.#I prefer other neighborhoods or areas: Ich bevorzuge andere Viertel oder Gebiete
de.#I rarely or never travel outside my nei: Ich verlasse mein Viertel selten oder nie
de.#We ask because money can limit how peop: Wir fragen, weil Geld einschränken kann, wie Menschen unterwegs sind.
de.#<p>A few questions about you. They help: Einige Fragen zu Ihrer Person. Sie helfen uns zu verstehen, wie leicht es für verschiedene Menschen ist, unterwegs zu sein und die Orte zu erreichen, die sie brauchen.
de.#<p>A few questions about you and where:
Einige Fragen zu Ihrer Person und dem Ort, an dem Sie wohnen.

Die Teilnahme ist freiwillig und Sie können jede Frage überspringen. Ihre Antworten werden nicht mit Ihrem Namen verknüpft und an keine Behörde weitergegeben.

Mehr über SmartUrbanity erfahren

Lesen Sie vor der Teilnahme die Datenschutzhinweise: Dort steht, wer auf Ihre Antworten zugreifen kann und wie lange sie gespeichert werden.
de.#This question is about you, not people: Diese Frage betrifft Sie selbst, nicht Personen, denen Sie helfen. Beispiele: Gehen, Sehen, Hören, Aufmerksamkeit, Schmerzen oder Mobilitätshilfen.

tr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Yanıtınız kaydedildi. Bu anketi doldurmak için zaman ayırdığınız için teşekkür ederiz.
tr.#What is your highest completed level of: Tamamladığınız en yüksek eğitim düzeyi nedir?
tr.#If you are still studying, choose the l: Hâlâ öğrenim görüyorsanız tamamladığınız son düzeyi seçin. Yurt dışında okuduysanız en yakın karşılığını seçin.
tr.#Which of the following best describes y: Aşağıdakilerden hangisi Municipio XII ile ilişkinizi en iyi tanımlar?
tr.#I live here (even without official regi: Burada yaşıyorum (resmi olarak kayıtlı ikametim olmasa bile)
tr.#I travel here regularly for work or stu: İş veya eğitim için buraya düzenli olarak geliyorum
tr.#I come here regularly for services, hea: Hizmetler, sağlık hizmetleri veya birine eşlik etmek için buraya düzenli olarak geliyorum
tr.#I come here now and then (e.g. to study: Buraya ara sıra geliyorum (örn. okumak, çalışmak veya insanlarla görüşmek için)
tr.#I'm visiting or staying for a short tim: Ziyaret için veya kısa süreliğine buradayım (örn. turizm, aile)
tr.#How strongly do you feel connected to t: Mahallenizdeki insanlara kendinizi ne kadar bağlı hissediyorsunuz?
tr.#Neither connected nor disconnected: Ne bağlı ne de kopuk hissediyorum
tr.#Thinking about the income of everyone w: Sizinle birlikte yaşayan herkesin gelirini düşündüğünüzde, aşağıdakilerden hangisi hanenizin ekonomik durumunu en iyi tanımlar?
tr.#We cover basic needs easily, with littl: Temel ihtiyaçları rahatça karşılıyoruz ama az para kalıyor
tr.#We can afford most things, with some ex: Çoğu şeyi karşılayabiliyoruz, ara sıra ekstra harcama da yapabiliyoruz
tr.#We are very comfortable and can easily: Maddi durumumuz çok iyi, ekstra harcamaları kolayca yapabiliyoruz
tr.#Do you have a disability, health condit: Hareket etmenizi zorlaştıran, hafif de olsa bir engeliniz, sağlık sorununuz veya kısıtlılığınız var mı?
tr.#In which neighbourhood or area of Munic: Şu anda Municipio XII’nin hangi mahallesinde veya bölgesinde yaşıyorsunuz?
tr.#If you use another name, choose the off: Başka bir ad kullanıyorsanız, evinize en yakın resmi mahalleyi veya Diğer seçeneğini seçin.
tr.#If you travel outside your neighborhood: Mahallenizin dışına çıkıyorsanız bunun başlıca nedenleri nelerdir?
tr.#Leisure activities (restaurants, cafes,: Boş zaman etkinlikleri (restoran, kafe, sinema, spor salonu)
tr.#Better prices or more choice of service: Başka yerlerde daha iyi fiyatlar veya daha fazla hizmet seçeneği
tr.#I prefer other neighborhoods or areas: Başka mahalleleri veya bölgeleri tercih ediyorum
tr.#I rarely or never travel outside my nei: Mahallemin dışına nadiren çıkarım veya hiç çıkmam
tr.#We ask because money can limit how peop: Bunu soruyoruz çünkü para, insanların nasıl yolculuk ettiğini sınırlayabilir.
tr.#<p>A few questions about you. They help: Sizin hakkınızda birkaç soru. Bu sorular, farklı kişilerin şehirde dolaşmasının ve ihtiyaç duydukları yerlere ulaşmasının ne kadar kolay olduğunu anlamamıza yardımcı olur.
tr.#<p>A few questions about you and where:
Siz ve yaşadığınız yer hakkında birkaç soru.

Katılım gönüllüdür ve istediğiniz soruyu atlayabilirsiniz. Yanıtlarınız adınızla ilişkilendirilmez ve hiçbir kamu kurumuna gönderilmez.

SmartUrbanity hakkında daha fazla bilgi edinin

Katılmadan önce gizlilik bildirimini okuyun: yanıtlarınıza kimlerin erişebileceğini ve ne kadar süre saklandıklarını açıklar.
tr.#This question is about you, not people: Bu soru sizinle ilgili, yardım ettiğiniz kişilerle değil. Örnekler: yürüme, görme, işitme, dikkat, ağrı veya hareket etmeye yardımcı araçlar.

fa.#Welcome to Your Profile: به پرسشنامه پروفایل خود خوش آمدید
fa.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: پاسخ شما ثبت شد. از وقتی که برای تکمیل این پرسشنامه گذاشتید سپاسگزاریم.
fa.#What is your highest completed level of: بالاترین مقطع تحصیلی که به پایان رسانده‌اید چیست؟
fa.#If you are still studying, choose the l: اگر هنوز درس می‌خوانید، آخرین مقطعی را که تمام کرده‌اید انتخاب کنید. اگر در خارج از کشور درس خوانده‌اید، نزدیک‌ترین مقطع معادل را انتخاب کنید.
fa.#Which of the following best describes y: کدام گزینه رابطه شما با Municipio XII را بهتر توصیف می‌کند؟
fa.#I live here (even without official regi: اینجا زندگی می‌کنم (حتی بدون اقامت رسمی ثبت‌شده)
fa.#I travel here regularly for work or stu: برای کار یا تحصیل به طور منظم به اینجا می‌آیم
fa.#I come here regularly for services, hea: به طور منظم برای استفاده از خدمات، مراقبت‌های درمانی یا همراهی با کسی به اینجا می‌آیم
fa.#I come here now and then (e.g. to study: گاهی اینجا می‌آیم (مثلاً برای درس، کار یا دیدن دیگران)
fa.#I'm visiting or staying for a short tim: به دیدن کسی آمده‌ام یا مدت کوتاهی اینجا می‌مانم (مثلاً گردشگری، خانواده)
fa.#How strongly do you feel connected to t: چقدر نسبت به مردم محله خود احساس تعلق دارید؟
fa.#Neither connected nor disconnected: نه احساس تعلق دارم نه احساس دوری
fa.#Thinking about the income of everyone w: با در نظر گرفتن درآمد همه کسانی که با شما زندگی می‌کنند، کدام یک از این گزینه‌ها وضعیت اقتصادی خانواده شما را بهتر توصیف می‌کند؟
fa.#We struggle to cover basic needs: برای تأمین نیازهای اولیه مشکل داریم
fa.#We can cover basic needs: می‌توانیم نیازهای اولیه را تأمین کنیم
fa.#We cover basic needs easily, with littl: نیازهای اولیه را به‌راحتی تأمین می‌کنیم، اما پول کمی می‌ماند
fa.#We can afford most things, with some ex: بیشتر چیزها را می‌توانیم تهیه کنیم و گاهی هزینه اضافی هم داریم
